title: Optical quantum teleportation with known amplitude distorting factors of teleported qubits
summary: We develop a quantum teleportation protocol of an unknown optical single rail qubit using a hybrid quantum channel composed of continuous variable (CV) states of certain parity. The quantum channel is characterized by two parameters: a squeezing parameter of single-mode squeezed vacuum (SMSV) state and the beam splitter (BS) parameter used to implement it. The CV part of the hybrid state belongs to Alice, while discrete variable (DV) half is controlled by Bob. The third parameter of the protocol is a parameter of the beam splitter, used to mix the CV components of the hybrid quantum state…
